message:
🚀 Flex ULTIMATE — Version 1.7.0 Official Public Release Notes
This major release introduces the definitive post-production suite for Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, featuring hands-free AI Voice Control, local Whisper AI silence & filler cleanup, Graph Editor 2.0, Nest Saver backup engine, and real-time cross-app visual collaboration [cite: 1, 3, 10, 13, 20, 32].

♦️ AI Voice Control & Smart Audio Workflows
* Flex AI Voice Control Bridge: Control your timeline hands-free with spoken commands via a robust file-mailbox transport layer connected to the desktop app [cite: 3, 4].
* AI Silence Cut & VAD: Automatically analyze audio waveforms, auto-detect audio-video links, and perform frame-accurate ripple cuts on dead space [cite: 6, 7].
* Local Whisper AI Cleanup: Transcribe clip audio locally with millisecond precision to cut filler words ("um", "like") and stutters with zero cloud fees [cite: 10, 11, 12].

♦️ Graph Editor 2.0 (The Flow Tab)
* Premium Curve Suite: Access 6 interactive math-based easing models (Bezier, Spline, Elastic, Bounce, Wave, Steps) with local, base, and user preset libraries [cite: 13, 14].
* Adaptive Greedy Fit Baking: Utilize a greedy-fit polyline reduction algorithm to bake smooth curves directly into keyframes within ExtendScript [cite: 15].
* Anti-Overshoot Safety Guards: Prevents spatial motion properties (Position, Anchor Point) from flying off-screen during keyframe interpolation adjustments [cite: 16].

♦️ Captions, Nests & Timeline Shortcuts
* Animated Word-Pop Subtitles: Ingest dynamic word-by-word captions into native Premiere Pro tracks with anti-flicker caption hold logic [cite: 17, 18, 19].
* True Dup Nest Cloning: Generate independent sequence clones with unique sequence IDs to bypass native Premiere limitations [cite: 26, 27].
* Timeline Power Shortcuts: Includes one-click Smart Adjustment Layers, diagonal Staircase Stagger tools, multi-tier QE Freeze Frame exporting, and a color-coded Timeline QC Checker [cite: 28, 29, 30, 31].

♦️ Backup Engine, Local Assets & Shared Canvas
* Nest Saver Backup Engine: Export nested sequences to a structured library complete with Apple ProRes 422 HQ export presets and rendered visual PNG thumbnails [cite: 20, 21, 22].
* Responsive Local Assets Library: Drag-and-drop local images, videos, audio, MOGRTs, SRTs, and LUTs directly into active bins or timeline tracks [cite: 24, 25].
* Shared Flex Canvas: Real-time, Figma-style visual reference board synced between After Effects and Premiere Pro using a 750ms revision watcher[cite: 32, 33].
